goals: Verify the URL parsing, parameter handling, and HTTP request execution capabilities of ApiRequest.
Verify that the Api class correctly processes GET requests, maps URL arguments, and deserializes the response into the specified object schema.
activities: Create an ApiRequest object with a GET method, a URL containing query parameters, and an additional params dictionary
Verify that the parsed URL parameters dictionary matches the expected combined parameters
Define a target URL for the Facebook Graph API
Create an ApiRequest object with a GET method and the target URL
Execute the API request to retrieve the response
Verify that the response is an instance of requests.Response
Verify that the response status code is 200
Define a parameterized target URL for the Facebook Graph API
Create an Api object with a GET method, the parameterized URL, a schema class, and an object class
Verify that the API arguments list correctly identifies the URL parameter
Call the API object with a specific parameter value to retrieve the data object
Verify that the returned object is an instance of the target object class
Verify that the ID of the returned object matches the expected integer value
